requirements.verbatim_text: Provide signed approved JV Agreement or SBA approved Mentor-Protege Agreement (if applicable) and;
requirements.atomic_obligation: Provide a signed approved JV Agreement or SBA-approved Mentor-Protege Agreement if applicable.

requirements.verbatim_text: NOTE: The non-price proposal shall include submittals for each non-price factor as specified below:
requirements.atomic_obligation: Include in the non-price proposal the submittals for each non-price factor listed below.

requirements.verbatim_text: This includes Offerors ensuring the Excel pricing cells do not include additional, hidden decimal places.
requirements.atomic_obligation: Ensure Excel pricing cells contain no hidden additional decimal places.

requirements.verbatim_text: If a Representation or Certification required by Section K of the RFP is not provided in SAM, include the representation or certification in your price proposal.
requirements.atomic_obligation: Include in the price proposal any Section K representation or certification not provided in SAM.

requirements.verbatim_text: If the Offeror is not required to submit a report to VETS-4212, include a brief statement and justification explaining why the Offeror is not required to submit a report.
requirements.atomic_obligation: If VETS-4212 filing is not required, include a brief statement and justification explaining why.

requirements.verbatim_text: All prospective contractors are required to register in the SPRS.
requirements.atomic_obligation: Register in the Supplier Performance Risk System (SPRS).

requirements.verbatim_text: Failure to have an active registration in the SPRS database at time of proposal submission will make an offeror ineligible for award.
requirements.atomic_obligation: Have an active SPRS registration at time of proposal submission to remain eligible for award.

requirements.verbatim_text: All prospective contractors are required to comply with the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST SP 800-171) DoD Assessment.
requirements.atomic_obligation: Comply with the NIST SP 800-171 DoD Assessment.

requirements.verbatim_text: In order to be eligible for award, the Offeror must be determined responsible in accordance with FAR Part 9, specifically 9.104-1, General Standards.
requirements.atomic_obligation: Be determinable as responsible under FAR 9.104-1 to be eligible for award.

requirements.verbatim_text: Provide name of financial institution, point of contact, telephone number, and email address.
requirements.atomic_obligation: Provide the financial institution's name, point of contact, telephone number and email address.

requirements.verbatim_text: Provide a signed statement of release giving the reference permission to release the information to the Navy.
requirements.atomic_obligation: Provide a signed statement of release permitting the reference to release information to the Navy.

requirements.verbatim_text: One (1) signed bank reference demonstrating adequate financial resources.
requirements.atomic_obligation: Provide one signed bank reference demonstrating adequate financial resources.

requirements.verbatim_text: Submit evidence of availability of working/operating capital, which will be used for the performance of the resultant contract.
requirements.atomic_obligation: Submit evidence of working/operating capital available for contract performance.

requirements.verbatim_text: For Joint Venture arrangements, submit the latest three complete fiscal year financial statements for each company in the Joint Venture and discuss the financial responsibilities among the companies.
requirements.atomic_obligation: For a Joint Venture, submit each member company's latest three fiscal year financial statements.

requirements.verbatim_text: Description of Offeror's facilities and equipment
requirements.atomic_obligation: Provide a description of the Offeror's facilities and equipment.

requirements.verbatim_text: Other Offeror's work presently under contract.
requirements.atomic_obligation: Provide the Offeror's other work presently under contract.

requirements.verbatim_text: Should the Offeror choose not to submit the above detailed Responsibility Determination Information via PIEE Solicitation Module, it shall be submitted via email to the Government's point of contact identified in Factor 4, Past Performance.
requirements.atomic_obligation: If not submitting responsibility information via PIEE, email it to the Factor 4 point of contact.

exhaustive_scope.description: Page ranges the golden set claims to annotate EXHAUSTIVELY. Precision computed inside this scope is a real error rate; outside it, a prediction may be a requirement the set simply never recorded.
exhaustive_scope.method: pass C, 2026-07-25: every prediction in range adversarially audited as binding-obligation or not; 25 genuine requirements promoted to ground truth, 4 rejected (one advisory 'requested to', three Government process statements imposing no offeror duty)
